local function isFiniteNumber(v: any): boolean
	return type(v) == "number" and v == v and v ~= math.huge and v ~= -math.huge
end

local function toSoundIdString(v: any): string
	if type(v) == "string" then
		return v
	elseif type(v) == "number" and v > 0 then
		return "rbxassetid://" .. tostring(math.floor(v))
	elseif type(v) == "table" then
		local inner = v.SoundId or v.Id or v.id or v.soundId
		if inner ~= nil and inner ~= v then
			return toSoundIdString(inner)
		end
	end
	return ""
end

-- Try to find the sound id for a director sound name (e.g. "Coin") in GameAssets.
local function assetSoundId(name: string): string
	if GameAssets == nil then
		return ""
	end
	local ok, res = pcall(function(): string
		local ga: any = GameAssets
		for _, key in ipairs({ "Sounds", "sounds", "SOUNDS" }) do
			local tbl = ga[key]
			if type(tbl) == "table" then
				local s = toSoundIdString(tbl[name])
				if s ~= "" then
					return s
				end
			end
		end
		return ""
	end)
	if ok and type(res) == "string" then
		return res
	end
	return ""
end

local function configSoundId(): string
	-- Prefer the verified GameAssets coin id, then the config id.
	local a = assetSoundId("Coin")
	if a ~= "" then
		return a
	end
	return toSoundIdString(Cfg.CASHIN_SOUND_ID)
end

local function pitchForTier(tier: number): number
	local fn = Cfg.pitchForTier
	if type(fn) == "function" then
		local ok, res = pcall(fn, tier)
		if ok and isFiniteNumber(res) then
			return res
		end
	end
	return math.clamp(1 + 0.12 * (tier - 1), 0.5, 2)
end

local function tierColorFor(tier: number): Color3
	local tc: any = Cfg.TIER_COLORS
	if type(tc) == "table" then
		local c = tc[tier]
		if typeof(c) == "Color3" then
			return c
		end
	end
	return FLASH_COLOR
end

		end
	end
	return false
end

-- Fallback discovery: decorate any workspace part that looks like a collector
-- if nothing has been registered through decorateCollector yet.
local function scanForCollectors()
	local now = os.clock()
	if now - lastScan < 2 then
		return
	end
	lastScan = now
	for _, d in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
		if d:IsA("BasePart") and string.find(string.lower(d.Name), "collector", 1, true) then
			if not string.find(d.Name, "CashIn", 1, true) and not isRegistered(d) then
				CashInService.decorateCollector(d)
			end
		end
	end
end

local function findCollector(pos: Vector3): CollectorInfo?
	local best: CollectorInfo? = nil
	local bestDist = math.huge
	for i = #collectors, 1, -1 do
		local info = collectors[i]
		if info.part.Parent == nil then
			table.remove(collectors, i)
		else
			local d = (info.part.Position - pos).Magnitude
			if d < bestDist then
				bestDist = d
				best = info
			end
		end
	end
	if best == nil and #collectors > 0 then
		best = collectors[#collectors]
	end
	return best
end

-- Resolve a BasePart / Model / Vector3 into a part that can hold an attachment.
local function resolveHolder(at: any): BasePart?
	if typeof(at) == "Vector3" then
		local holder = Instance.new("Part")
		holder.Name = "FxAnchor"
		holder.Anchored, holder.CanCollide, holder.CanQuery, holder.CanTouch = true, false, false, false
		holder.Transparency, holder.Size, holder.Position = 1, Vector3.new(0.2, 0.2, 0.2), at
		holder.Parent = workspace
		Debris:AddItem(holder, 4)
		return holder
	end
	if typeof(at) == "Instance" then
		if at:IsA("BasePart") then
			return at
		end
		if at:IsA("Model") then
			if at.PrimaryPart then
				return at.PrimaryPart
			end
			local best: BasePart? = nil
			local bestVol = -1
			for _, d in at:GetDescendants() do
				if d:IsA("BasePart") then
					local v = d.Size.X * d.Size.Y * d.Size.Z
					if v > bestVol then
						best, bestVol = d, v
					end
				end
			end
			return best
		end
	end
	return nil
end

-- A short-lived invisible anchored part at a world position (survives the source part being destroyed).
local function makeAnchor(pos: Vector3, life: number): BasePart
	local holder = Instance.new("Part")
	holder.Name = "FxAnchor"
	holder.Anchored, holder.CanCollide, holder.CanQuery, holder.CanTouch = true, false, false, false
	holder.Transparency, holder.Size, holder.Position = 1, Vector3.new(0.2, 0.2, 0.2), pos
	holder.Parent = workspace
	Debris:AddItem(holder, life)
	return holder
end

-- Play a sound by name. Always creates a Sound and calls :Play(), cleaned up by Debris.
-- With a parent (BasePart / Attachment / Model) it is a 3D world sound; without one it plays as a UI
-- sound from SoundService (client: local only; server: everyone hears it).
function GameAssets.sound(name: string, parent: Instance?, pitch: number?): Sound?
	local id = GameAssets.Sounds[name]
	if not id or id == "" then
		return nil
	end
	local s = Instance.new("Sound")
	s.Name = name
	s.SoundId = id
	s.Volume = VOLUMES[name] or 0.5
	s.PlaybackSpeed = pitch or (PITCHES[name] or 1) * (0.95 + math.random() * 0.1)
	local target: Instance? = parent
	if target and not (target:IsA("BasePart") or target:IsA("Attachment")) then
		target = resolveHolder(target)
	end
	s.Parent = target or SoundService
	s:Play()
	Debris:AddItem(s, 6)
	countTelemetry("sounds_played", 1)
	return s
end

-- Backwards compatible alias.
function GameAssets.play(name: string, parent: Instance?, pitch: number?): Sound?
	return GameAssets.sound(name, parent, pitch)
end

-- Looping background music at low volume (call once, on the client).
function GameAssets.music(name: string?, volume: number?): Sound?
	local id = GameAssets.Sounds[name or "Music"]
	if not id or id == "" then
		return nil
	end
	local s = Instance.new("Sound")
	s.Name, s.SoundId, s.Looped, s.Volume = "Music", id, true, volume or 0.25
	s.Parent = SoundService
	s:Play()
	return s
end

-- CashInFx (client): cash-in popups, sounds, particles, HUD pulse, purchase confetti, spinning collector rings.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")
local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")

local localPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("CashInConfig", 10) :: ModuleScript) :: any

-- Sliding one-second window of popup timestamps
local stamps: { number } = {}
local function allowPopup(): boolean
	local now = os.clock()
	local kept: { number } = {}
	for _, t in stamps do
		if now - t < 1 then
			table.insert(kept, t)
		end
	end
	stamps = kept
	if #stamps >= Config.MAX_POPUPS_PER_SECOND then
		return false
	end
	table.insert(stamps, now)
	return true
end

local function makeAnchor(pos: Vector3, lifetime: number): Part
	local part = Instance.new("Part")
	part.Name = "FxAnchor"
	part.Size = Vector3.new(0.5, 0.5, 0.5)
	part.Transparency = 1
	part.Anchored = true
	part.CanCollide = false
	part.CanQuery = false
	part.CanTouch = false
	part.CastShadow = false
	part.CFrame = CFrame.new(pos)
	part.Parent = workspace
	Debris:AddItem(part, lifetime)
	return part
end

local function playSound(parent: Instance, id: string, speed: number, volume: number)
	local s = Instance.new("Sound")
	s.SoundId = id
	s.Volume = volume
	s.PlaybackSpeed = speed
	s.RollOffMaxDistance = 120
	s.Parent = parent
	s:Play()
	Debris:AddItem(s, 3)
end

local function pulseHud()
	local pg = localPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
	if not pg then
		return
	end
	local label = pg:FindFirstChild("CashLabel", true)
	if not label or not label:IsA("TextLabel") then
		return
	end
	local scale = label:FindFirstChild("CashPulse") :: UIScale?
	if not scale then
		scale = Instance.new("UIScale")
		scale.Name = "CashPulse"
		scale.Parent = label
	end
	local sc = scale :: UIScale
	sc.Scale = 1
	local up = TweenService:Create(sc, TweenInfo.new(0.1, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { Scale = 1.2 })
	up.Completed:Connect(function()
		TweenService:Create(sc, TweenInfo.new(0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { Scale = 1 }):Play()
	end)
	up:Play()
end

local function sparkles(part: Part)
	local e = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
	e.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255, 226, 90), Color3.fromRGB(255, 180, 40))
	e.LightEmission = 1
	e.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.5, 0.9)
	e.Speed = NumberRange.new(8, 16)
	e.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(180, 180)
	e.Acceleration = Vector3.new(0, -10, 0)
	e.Size = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.7), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0) })
	e.Rate = 0
	e.Enabled = false
	e.Parent = part
	e:Emit(15)
end

local function popupText(pos: Vector3, amount: number, color: Color3)
	local part = makeAnchor(pos + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0), 1.6)
	local gui = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
	gui.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(140, 50)
	gui.AlwaysOnTop = true
	gui.StudsOffsetWorldSpace = Vector3.zero
	gui.Adornee = part
	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.Text = "+$" .. tostring(math.floor(amount + 0.5))
	label.TextScaled = true
	label.Font = Enum.Font.LuckiestGuy
	label.TextColor3 = color
	label.Parent = gui
	local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	stroke.Thickness = 3
	stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(28, 22, 38)
	stroke.Parent = label
	gui.Parent = part
	local info = TweenInfo.new(1, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
	TweenService:Create(gui, info, { StudsOffsetWorldSpace = Vector3.new(0, 5, 0) }):Play()
	TweenService:Create(label, info, { TextTransparency = 1 }):Play()
	TweenService:Create(stroke, info, { Transparency = 1 }):Play()
end

local function onCashIn(amount: any, tier: any, pos: any)
	if type(amount) ~= "number" or amount ~= amount or typeof(pos) ~= "Vector3" then
		return
	end
	if not allowPopup() then
		return
	end
	local anchor = makeAnchor(pos, 3)
	local vol: number = Config.CASHIN_VOLUME or 0.4
	playSound(anchor, Config.CASHIN_SOUND_ID, Config.pitchForTier(tier), vol)
	sparkles(anchor)
	popupText(pos, amount, Config.colorForTier(tier))
	pulseHud()
end

local function onPurchaseFx(pos: any)
	local target: Vector3? = nil
	if typeof(pos) == "Vector3" then
		target = pos
	else
		local char = localPlayer.Character
		local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if hrp and hrp:IsA("BasePart") then
			target = hrp.Position
		end
	end
	if not target then
		return
	end
	if not allowPopup() then
		return
	end
	local anchor = makeAnchor(target, 3)
	local popVol: number = Config.POP_VOLUME or 0.5
	playSound(anchor, Config.POP_SOUND_ID, 1.1, popVol)
	local e = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
	e.Color = ColorSequence.new({
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(255, 90, 90)),
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.25, Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 60)),
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, Color3.fromRGB(90, 220, 110)),
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.75, Color3.fromRGB(80, 170, 255)),
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(200, 100, 255)),
	})
	e.LightEmission = 0.5
	e.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.7, 1.2)
	e.Speed = NumberRange.new(14, 28)
	e.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(180, 180)
	e.Acceleration = Vector3.new(0, -25, 0)
	e.RotSpeed = NumberRange.new(-200, 200)
	e.Size = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.6), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0.2) })
	e.Rate = 0
	e.Enabled = false
	e.Parent = anchor
	e:Emit(30)
end

-- Ring spinning (client-local)
local rings: { [BasePart]: boolean } = {}
local function addRing(inst: Instance)
	if inst:IsA("BasePart") then
		rings[inst] = true
	end
end
for _, inst in CollectionService:GetTagged(Config.RING_TAG) do
	addRing(inst)
end
CollectionService:GetInstanceAddedSignal(Config.RING_TAG):Connect(addRing)
CollectionService:GetInstanceRemovedSignal(Config.RING_TAG):Connect(function(inst: Instance)
	if inst:IsA("BasePart") then
		rings[inst] = nil
	end
end)
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt: number)
	local ang = math.rad(Config.RING_SPIN_DEG_PER_SEC) * dt
	for ring in rings do
		if ring.Parent then
			ring.CFrame = ring.CFrame * CFrame.Angles(0, ang, 0)
		else
			rings[ring] = nil
		end
	end
end)

local function findRemote(folder: Instance?, name: string): RemoteEvent?
	local r = folder and folder:WaitForChild(name, 10)
	if r and r:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
		return r
	end
	local direct = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild(name)
	if direct and direct:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
		return direct
	end
	return nil
end
